text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Oh crap! The expiration date on this 
takoyaki mix is today!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Letting things expire is a bad idea... I 
learned that the hard way before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gotta hurry up and buy some octopus!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make 'em into super tasty 
takoyaki, no doubt, so don't you go 
rotting away—just hold on!

And so, Tamamo Cross's mind became 
completely consumed by takoyaki, leading 
her to skip out on her training.
